records.name: Frank Li

claims.claim: College of Computing heading explicitly identifies assistant professor joint with ECE; biography identifies joint SCP/ECE appointment.
ECE profile official job title is Affiliate-LongTerm Res/Collab.
Georgia Tech HR defines affiliate statuses as unpaid Institute guests or affiliated-organization members entered in OneUSG for access; long-term research/collaboration is a distinct category.

records.decision_basis: Include for website-defined academic appointment scope: explicit institutional joint-professor statement is more specific about the academic appointment than the ECE directory job-code heading. This is not verification of payroll or FTE.
unresolved_evidence_issues: Why ECE job-code heading reports affiliate rather than professor is not established. HR policy does not say this code is equivalent to joint faculty, nor prove a professor appointment ended. Preserve discrepancy.

records.name: Brendan D Saltaformaggio

claims.claim: College of Computing heading identifies associate professor in SCP joint with ECE, corroborated by biography.
ECE official job title reports Affiliate-ShortTerm Res/Acces.
HR defines short-term research/access as a non-payroll affiliate category under six months.

records.decision_basis: Include for website-defined academic appointment scope based on explicit current institutional joint-professor heading and ECE presence. Do not infer payroll status from this recommendation.
unresolved_evidence_issues: Unexplained disagreement between ECE job-code field and institutional academic appointment. HR policy does not itself reconcile these sources.

records.name: Steven W McLaughlin

claims.claim: Central Georgia Tech Emeritus Faculty list records Steven McLaughlin, 1996–2025, Provost Emeritus, ECE.
Georgia Tech Engineering identifies former dean who became Cooper Union president on July 1, 2025.
Cooper Union announcement names his new presidency.

records.decision_basis: Exclude based on end-dated Georgia Tech service and corroborated move, not merely because the administrative title contains emeritus. No current regular ECE appointment found.

records.name: Raymond P Vito

claims.claim: CREATE-X profile explicitly says retired vice provost, professor emeritus of Mechanical Engineering, currently working part-time.
Central emeritus list places him in Mechanical Engineering as vice provost emeritus.

records.decision_basis: Exclude: specific professor-emeritus and retirement evidence resolves the ambiguity left by administrative emeritus title alone.

records.name: May D Wang

claims.claim: Current BME institutional biography explicitly describes full professor of Biomedical Engineering and Electrical and Computer Engineering.
Georgia Tech Bioengineering and Bioscience profile identifies professor of BME, ECE and CSE.

records.decision_basis: Include under current official academic appointment statements and ECE roster membership. BME primary membership does not negate explicit ECE professorship.
unresolved_evidence_issues: A 2021 external interview characterized ECE as adjunct; current institutional profiles are stronger for this website-defined snapshot. No current explicit institutional adjunct designation was found in prior ECE taxonomy audit.

summary.qualification: Recommendations establish website-defined academic appointments, not payroll employment, appointment fractions, or a certified HR census. Under a policy requiring all sources agree, Li and Saltaformaggio remain unresolved.
